description: This file defines the TreeInterpreter class for evaluating JMESPath Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) expressions. It traverses AST nodes and applies evaluation logic, supporting various node types such as field, subexpression, index, projection, and logical operators.

classes.name: TreeInterpreter
classes.description: Class responsible for interpreting JMESPath AST nodes to evaluate expressions over data structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TreeInterpreter instance, optionally with a custom function dispatcher.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Initiates evaluation of a JMESPath AST node with the provided data.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Recursively processes AST nodes based on their type, evaluating parts of the expression accordingly.
